zh-CN.title: 看一页，听你的声音
materials: 家里已有的绘本，或一张大幅图片
steps: 选一页简单图片，你把书拿稳。
宝宝清醒、舒服时，让他看看，不必追着他的视线。
慢慢说出一个物品的名字，再停一停。
如果他转开或累了，就结束，也算一起读过了。
zh-CN.why: 给宝宝留一点看、听和回应你的时间。

en-US.title: One picture, your voice
materials: A book you already have, or a large picture
steps: Hold a page with a simple picture securely.
Offer a look when your baby is awake and comfortable; do not chase their gaze.
Name one thing slowly, then pause.
If they turn away or seem tired, stop. That still counts as reading together.
en-US.why: A small opening for your baby to look, listen and respond.

zh-CN.title: 给身边的东西起名字
steps: 抱稳宝宝或让他在安全位置躺好。
指一指远处的灯、门或窗，不把物品递到嘴边。
说“这是窗，窗外有光”，只用短句。
停下来听听宝宝的声音，用相近的声音回应。
zh-CN.why: 把熟悉的声音和日常看到的东西连在一起。

en-US.title: Names around us
steps: Hold your baby securely or settle them safely.
Point to a light, door or window at a distance; keep objects away from their mouth.
Say a short phrase such as “A window. There is light outside.”
Pause for their sounds, then gently echo them.
en-US.why: Connects familiar voices with things in everyday life.

zh-CN.title: 今天的你好小仪式
steps: 在宝宝清醒时，靠近到他舒服的距离。
说一句固定的问候，比如“早上好，我们见面啦”。
唱一句你熟悉的短歌。
看宝宝的反应，慢慢重复一次或就此结束。
zh-CN.why: 重复的小问候让相处更有熟悉感。

en-US.title: A little hello ritual
steps: When your baby is awake, get comfortably close.
Use a familiar greeting such as “Good morning, here we are.”
Sing one line of a song you know.
Watch their response; repeat gently once or finish.
en-US.why: A repeated greeting makes shared time feel familiar.

zh-CN.title: 安静下来的一首歌
steps: 在睡前照护开始前，把环境声音放轻。
宝宝还清醒时，抱稳他，或坐在安全位置旁。
轻声唱一小段固定的歌，不强迫他入睡。
随后按你们原有的安全睡眠安排进行，不把书或玩具留在睡眠空间。
zh-CN.why: 一段相同的轻声歌，可以作为日常过渡的提示。

en-US.title: One quiet song
steps: Before the bedtime routine, soften surrounding noise.
While your baby is awake, hold them securely or sit beside their safe space.
Sing a familiar short song softly; do not try to force sleep.
Continue your usual safe sleep arrangement, leaving books and toys out of the sleep space.
en-US.why: A familiar soft song can mark an everyday transition.

zh-CN.title: 看看你的表情
steps: 在宝宝舒服、清醒的时候，面对他坐好。
用自然的笑容，说“我看到你啦”。
停一下，看他有没有看你、动一动或发出声音。
用温和的表情回应；不做突然大声或吓人的动作。
zh-CN.why: 练习留意彼此的小信号，不需要宝宝完成任务。

en-US.title: A face to notice
steps: Sit facing your baby when they are awake and comfortable.
Smile naturally and say “I see you.”
Pause to notice a look, movement or sound.
Respond gently, without sudden loud or startling gestures.
en-US.why: A chance to notice little signals, without asking your baby to perform.

zh-CN.title: 镜子里的我们
materials: 已有的完整防碎镜；没有就用面对面游戏
steps: 由成人拿稳镜子，让宝宝保持安全姿势。
看着镜子，说“这是你，这是我”。
做一个慢慢的微笑，停下来观察。
宝宝不感兴趣时就收起镜子，不让他啃咬或独自拿镜子。
zh-CN.why: 一起观察表情，为你们的回应留一点空间。

en-US.title: Us in the mirror
materials: An intact shatterproof mirror, or simply face each other
steps: An adult holds the mirror securely while the baby stays safely positioned.
Say “Here is you. Here is me.”
Make a slow smile and pause to watch.
Put it away if they lose interest; do not let them mouth or hold the mirror alone.
en-US.why: A quiet chance to look at expressions and respond together.

zh-CN.title: 看你的手慢慢走
steps: 让清醒的宝宝在安全位置，头和身体有合适支撑。
把手放在他容易看到的位置，留出距离。
很慢地向一边移动一点，再停住。
跟随宝宝的兴趣，不拉动他的头、手脚，也不要求他追看。
zh-CN.why: 用很小的移动，提供一次共同注意的机会。

en-US.title: Follow a slow hand
steps: Settle your awake baby safely with appropriate head and body support.
Place your hand where they can easily see it, leaving space.
Move it a little to one side, very slowly, then pause.
Follow their interest; never pull their head or limbs or require them to track it.
en-US.why: A small movement offers a moment of shared attention.

zh-CN.title: 窗边看一会儿
steps: 你抱稳宝宝，站在离窗、窗绳和热源安全的距离。
指向窗外一块颜色或一片树影。
轻声说“树叶在动”或“这里是绿色”。
停一停，再回到原来的位置；不把宝宝放在窗台上。
zh-CN.why: 把日常环境变成一小段不赶时间的陪伴。

en-US.title: A moment by the window
materials: A window viewed from a safe position
steps: Hold your baby securely, well away from the window, cords and heat sources.
Point to a color or a moving tree shadow outside.
Say “The leaves move” or “That is green.”
Pause, then return; never place the baby on a windowsill.
en-US.why: Turns an ordinary view into a little unhurried time together.

zh-CN.title: 让孩子当翻页的人
steps: 选两三页，不需要从头读完。
让孩子指一指或翻一页，你帮忙拿稳。
描述他正在看的东西，再问一个简单问题。
把他的词接成短句；如果想结束，就一起合上书。
zh-CN.why: 从孩子注意的地方开始，更容易轮流说一点。

en-US.title: Let your child turn the page
materials: A sturdy book you already have
steps: Choose two or three pages; you do not need to finish the book.
Let your child point or turn a page while you steady it.
Describe what they notice, then ask one simple question.
Build on their words with a short sentence; close the book together when they are done.
en-US.why: Starting with their interest makes room for a little back-and-forth.

zh-CN.title: 拍两下，唱一句
steps: 坐在安全、舒服的地方。
轻轻拍两下手，唱一句熟悉的儿歌。
停下来让孩子自由回应，不要求拍准。
换成孩子带节奏，你来学一学。
zh-CN.why: 轮流带领一个小节奏，让孩子也有表达的机会。

en-US.title: Two claps, one song
steps: Sit somewhere safe and comfortable.
Clap softly twice and sing one familiar line.
Pause for any response; matching the beat is optional.
Let your child lead a rhythm and copy them.
en-US.why: Taking turns with a little rhythm gives your child a way to express themselves.

zh-CN.title: 两件玩具回家
materials: 两件已有的大玩具和收纳处
steps: 选两件适龄、没有小零件的玩具。
一起指认它们要回到哪里。
你收一件，再邀请孩子收另一件，不强迫。
说“现在它们回家了”，就结束，不扩大成整屋任务。
zh-CN.why: 把收拾变成一个范围很小、看得见的步骤。

en-US.title: Two toys go home
materials: Two age-appropriate large toys and their storage place
steps: Choose two toys without small parts.
Point together to where they belong.
Put one away, then invite your child to do the other without forcing it.
Say “They are home now,” and stop; this is not a whole-room task.
en-US.why: Makes tidying a small, visible step.

zh-CN.title: 饭前的一句小问候
steps: 在吃饭前或吃完后，坐在一起。
说“今天你看到了什么？”也可以只讲自己的一个发现。
等孩子用话、手势或表情回答。
用一句短话回应；不在咀嚼时要求说话，也不把吃多少当条件。
zh-CN.why: 在熟悉的日常时点，留一小段聊天的空隙。

en-US.title: A little table hello
steps: Sit together before or after a meal.
Ask “What did you notice today?” or share one thing you noticed.
Wait for words, gestures or an expression.
Respond briefly; do not ask for speech while chewing or make it depend on eating an amount.
en-US.why: Leaves a small opening for conversation at a familiar point in the day.

zh-CN.title: 我们来做表情
steps: 你先做一个自然的笑脸。
问“这个脸看起来像什么心情？”孩子可以不回答。
试一个轻轻皱眉的表情，说一个日常小情境。
让孩子挑一个表情，你来模仿，不评价对错。
zh-CN.why: 提供一些谈心情的词，不急着判断孩子的感受。

en-US.title: Faces we can make
steps: Start with a natural smile.
Ask “What feeling might this face show?” An answer is optional.
Try a gentle frown and describe an everyday situation.
Let your child choose a face for you to copy, without marking it right or wrong.
en-US.why: Offers words for feelings without deciding what your child must feel.

zh-CN.title: 小熊今天怎么了
materials: 已有的适龄软玩具；没有就用你的手
steps: 让玩具或你的手说“今天我有点不高兴”。
问“我们可以陪它做点什么？”
跟着孩子的办法，坐一会儿、说一句话或抱一抱。
问孩子愿不愿意也说说；不愿意就结束。
zh-CN.why: 用游戏留出谈感受的空间，不要求孩子马上讲自己。

en-US.title: How is teddy today?
materials: An age-appropriate soft toy, or your hand
steps: Let the toy or your hand say “I feel a little unhappy today.”
Ask “How could we keep it company?”
Follow your child’s idea: sit, say something or offer a hug.
Invite your child to share too, but finish if they do not want to.
en-US.why: Play can leave space to talk about feelings without demanding a personal account.

zh-CN.title: 想象中的小路
materials: 一块清空障碍物、防滑的地面
steps: 先把地上的绊脚物收好。
用手指指一条短短的“想象小路”。
你们慢慢走几步，停下时说“到站啦”。
让孩子选择下一站；不需要跳高、爬家具或比赛。
zh-CN.why: 把一点身体活动和轮流选择放在同一个小游戏里。

en-US.title: An imaginary path
steps: Remove anything that could trip you.
Point out a short imaginary path.
Walk a few slow steps and say “We arrived” when you stop.
Let your child choose the next stop; no high jumps, furniture climbing or racing.
en-US.why: Combines a little movement with taking turns choosing.

zh-CN.title: 散步找一种颜色
materials: 安全步行路线；也可以在室内
steps: 选一个颜色，比如绿色。
成人全程陪伴，按你们平常的安全方式慢慢走。
看见这种颜色时指一指，停在安全的位置说一说。
找到两三个就回来，不摘、捡或吃不认识的东西。
zh-CN.why: 给散步一个共同观察的小主题。

en-US.title: Find one color on a walk
materials: A safe walking route, or an indoor space
steps: Choose one color, such as green.
An adult stays close and walks slowly using your usual safety arrangements.
Point it out and pause somewhere safe to talk.
Return after two or three finds; do not pick up or eat unfamiliar things.
en-US.why: Gives a short walk a shared theme to notice.

zh-CN.title: 故事还有另一个结尾
materials: 一本已有的书，或你熟悉的小故事
steps: 讲一段短故事，在结尾前停住。
问“你觉得接下来会怎样？”
听完孩子的版本，再分享你的一个版本。
选你们喜欢的结尾，再讲一遍，不需要标准答案。
zh-CN.why: 给想象和轮流表达留出位置。

en-US.title: Another ending
materials: A book you have, or a short story you know
steps: Tell a short story and pause before the ending.
Ask “What might happen next?”
Listen to your child’s version, then share one of your own.
Choose an ending you enjoy and retell it; there is no correct answer.
en-US.why: Makes room for imagination and taking turns expressing ideas.

zh-CN.title: 如果杯子会说话
materials: 一个完整、无热液体的已有杯子，由成人拿稳
steps: 你拿稳杯子，说“如果它会说话，会说什么？”
让孩子给它起个名字。
一起编两三句它今天的小经历。
最后让它说一句告别，把杯子放回安全位置。
zh-CN.why: 从日常物品开始，把想法组织成一个小故事。

en-US.title: If a cup could talk
materials: An intact cup with no hot liquid, held by an adult
steps: Hold the cup and ask “What would it say if it could talk?”
Let your child give it a name.
Make two or three lines about its day together.
Give it a goodbye line and put it safely away.
en-US.why: An everyday object becomes a starting point for a little story.

zh-CN.title: 睡前三件小事
steps: 在睡前选一个舒服的聊天时刻。
轮流说今天一个开心或有趣的小事。
说一个今天需要帮忙的地方，孩子可以跳过。
最后一起说一句明天想做的小事，再接上原有的睡前安排。
zh-CN.why: 用熟悉的顺序收尾，让聊天更容易开始。

en-US.title: Three little things before bed
steps: Choose a comfortable moment before the usual bedtime routine.
Take turns naming one fun or interesting thing from today.
Name something you needed help with; your child may skip it.
Share one little thing you would like to do tomorrow, then continue your usual routine.
en-US.why: A familiar sequence can make a closing conversation easier to start.

zh-CN.title: 出门前的小检查
steps: 一起想出出门前的三件事，比如鞋、外套、牵手。
让孩子用话或手势带着你检查。
少了一件，就一起补上，不责备。
用一句固定的“我们准备好啦”结束；靠近道路时仍由成人负责安全。
zh-CN.why: 让过渡中的步骤更清楚，也给孩子一个参与的位置。

en-US.title: A little leaving-home check
materials: Things you already need to take
steps: Choose three checks, such as shoes, a jacket and holding hands.
Let your child lead the checks with words or gestures.
If something is missing, get it together without blame.
Finish with “We are ready”; an adult remains responsible for road safety.
en-US.why: Makes transition steps clearer and gives your child a part to play.

zh-CN.title: 心情像什么天气
materials: 不需要额外物品；可用已有纸笔画一画
steps: 你先说“我的心情像有点云，也有点太阳”。
邀请孩子选自己的天气，不替他选。
问“你想有人陪着，还是先安静一会儿？”
一起选一个小办法；心情不必马上变好。
zh-CN.why: 用比喻谈感受，尊重孩子自己怎么描述。

en-US.title: What weather is your feeling?
materials: No extra supplies; optional paper and crayons you have
steps: Start with “My feeling is a little cloudy and a little sunny.”
Invite your child to choose their weather; do not choose for them.
Ask “Would you like company or a little quiet?”
Choose one small option together; feelings do not have to change right away.
en-US.why: A metaphor offers a way to talk about feelings in their own words.

zh-CN.title: 两只手的小对话
steps: 把两只手当成两个小角色。
让一个说“我想玩”，另一个说“我想休息”。
请孩子想一个两个角色都能表达的办法。
照着演一小段，最后问哪句最想用在今天。
zh-CN.why: 在轻松的角色里练习表达不同的需要。

en-US.title: A conversation between two hands
steps: Turn your hands into two little characters.
Let one say “I want to play” and the other “I want to rest.”
Invite your child to find a way for both to express their needs.
Act out a short exchange, then choose a phrase to try today.
en-US.why: A playful role lets you practice expressing different needs.

zh-CN.title: 慢慢走的动物朋友
materials: 清空障碍物、防滑的地面
steps: 确认有一小块安全空地。
选一种动物，用慢慢走路的方式模仿。
让孩子选下一种，你们轮流带领。
觉得累就停，不做高处跳跃、不爬家具，也不比赛快慢。
zh-CN.why: 在短短的身体活动里分享选择和想象。

en-US.title: Slow animal friends
steps: Find a small safe open space.
Choose an animal and copy it with a slow walking movement.
Let your child choose the next one and take turns leading.
Stop when tired; no high jumps, furniture climbing or speed contests.
en-US.why: A short movement game shares choice and imagination.

zh-CN.title: 公园里看见三件事
materials: 安全的户外路线；室内窗边也可以
steps: 成人陪着，选一个安全的观察位置。
各自找一件看到、听到或闻到的事。
轮流说说，也可以画在已有纸上。
找满三件就结束，不触碰陌生动物或采食植物。
zh-CN.why: 把注意力一起放在身边的环境里。

en-US.title: Three things to notice
materials: A safe outdoor route, or a safe indoor window view
steps: With an adult present, choose a safe place to observe.
Each notice something you can see, hear or smell.
Take turns sharing, or draw on paper you already have.
Finish after three things; do not touch unfamiliar animals or eat plants.
en-US.why: Brings your attention together to the world around you.
